# Customs quantity samples — provenance

**These files were not captured from acceptance.** They were generated by serialising the real
generated types (`ProcessedChedInformationResponseType` and friends) with `XmlSerializer`, so their
element names, ordering and namespaces are exactly what the deserialiser expects.

That guarantees they round-trip — the snapshot tests show every field mapping through rather than
silently becoming `null`, which is the usual failure mode of hand-authored SOAP samples. What it
does **not** guarantee is that TracesNT actually sends this shape. In particular these samples
assume that `ReservedQuantity` and `ConsumedQuantity` are populated on a
`QuantityManagementIndication = "0"` read, which has not been confirmed by observation. See the
open question in [ADR-0006](../../../../docs/adr/0006-customs-quantity-management.md).

**Replace these files with captured acceptance responses when that call is made.** If the captured
responses differ, the tests will say so.

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `ProcessedChedResponse_CHEDA.GB.2026.0000123.xml` | Two available lines, two reservations against different MRNs, one consumption |
| `ProcessedChedResponse_NoSummary.xml` | A CHED that exists but has no `QuantityManagementSummary` — must yield 502 |
| `ProcessedChedResponse_UnknownChed.xml` | A successful response with no `ChedCertificate` — TracesNT's not-found signal, must yield 404 |
